correctness.rationale: Dirichlet gaps and midpoint geometry give the exact Beta marginal; conditioning on one shared spacing gives J_adj and aggregating four disjoint spacings gives J_non. The n=3/4 polynomials factor exactly. For n>=5 a strictly decreasing F+G proof uses (1+u)^r<1/(1-r^2 q^2) for r>=3, q<1/r; q>=1/r and q>=1/2 follow by elementary signs. Nonneighbor strict negativity follows by conditional beta monotonicity. Algebraic Taylor expansion proves both asymptotic limits. The standalone verifier independently re-integrates exact rational polynomial densities.

value.rationale: The natural observable is whether individual Voronoi cells exceed a common size threshold in a fixed sample. The theorem completely classifies covariances by sample cardinality and adjacency, identifies a unique finite-sample independence point at the mean cell length despite nonlinear dependence otherwise, and shows a distinct Poisson-scale positive neighbor limit versus order-1/n negative long-range dependence. These structural statements are not provided by the routine marginal Beta law or raw cell-length correlations.
